final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS a, SUM(derived_total_cost)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(product_price),0) AS r FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), m AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS mr FROM inv WHERE r IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(r) - (SELECT mr FROM m) AS ratio_excess FROM inv WHERE r > (SELECT mr FROM m)
